outcome.Summary: Fixed the INI parser in ini/ini.go to match its documented format: lines are now trimmed before processing (whitespace-only lines and indented comments are ignored), full-line '#' comments are handled, section names are lower-cased, the first '=' splits key/value (values may contain '='), quoted values keep inner whitespace exactly, inline comments are stripped only at the first " ;" or " #" in unquoted values (and a quoted value with a trailing comment is unwrapped correctly), and repeated keys now overwrite earlier values. Verified with `go test ./...` (pass) plus a temporary edge-case test (later removed) covering every documented bullet, including 'a;b' staying intact and '#ff0000' not being treated as a comment.
